_doc: The v1 rigid-twin contact model (coldgas-rigid@1, before the 2026-10-21 calibration) as a parameter override for RigidTwin({vehicle}) / Twin(vehicle=) (spec/README.md 5.11, 5.12): scalar suspension, Coulomb tyres, no wheel spin, no toe, the original 20 hull points, no floor points. With it the twins reproduce the coldgas-rigid@1 trajectories bit for bit (python/tests/test_twin_v2.py against v1-reference.json). Every contact parameter is given explicitly, so it does not depend on the spec's fitted values.
